messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — saw candidate NPS drop to 64% for onsite interviews last week. Main callouts: scorecards feel vague and some candidates reported scheduling/Zoom invite problems. Example: 'interviewer didn't have rubric, asked same question twice.'

Amar Patel: Oof. Do we know if this is the ATS -> calendar integration issue? I noticed a couple of zoom links missing after the recent invite-template change.

Kelly Thompson: We had one candidate sit in the waiting room for 10 mins because the invite included the literal placeholder {zoom_link}. Not great.

Jordan Lee: @Amar can you paste a failing webhook payload? I rolled back one template earlier but want the exact error.

Amar Patel: here's the payload snippet I grabbed from the logs:
```
{"candidate_id":"C-1234","panel":[],"zoom_invite":null}
```
Panel array empty -> renderer returned no link, then our invite service dropped the field. Also saw a 500 from zoom-service when organizer was missing.

OpsBot: [automated] ATS integration: webhook delivery failed for candidate C-1234 (status 500).

Rebecca Owens: Ok — proposed triage: 1) quick fallback so invites always include a join URL (even if temp), 2) update scorecard guidance + make a few key fields mandatory, 3) schedule a 30-min calibration session for interviewers this week. Who's available?

Kelly Thompson: I'll join the calibration. Also please make 'role fit' and 'decision rationale' required fields on scorecard.

Mia Chen: +1 on required fields. Also suggest adding a 3-item checklist in every interview invite: '1) open scorecard, 2) use rubric v2, 3) submit within 24h' — tiny friction but might help compliance.

Amar Patel: I'll open a PR for the fallback invite template (PR #3429) and add server-side guard so an empty panel doesn't drop the zoom link. ETA EOD tomorrow. Logs show error tag `zoom_template_render_error`.

Jordan Lee: Thanks — I'll add an alert: if zoom invite failures > 3/hr we auto-create an incident and notify eng-oncall.

Rebecca Owens: I'll create the calibration event (Thu 3pm PT) and drop a concise doc in People Ops resources. Link will be shared here.

Kelly Thompson: Also think we should craft one slide for hiring managers: what to expect from scorecards and how to prep interviewers. Short, shareable.

Mia Chen: Action items recap: Amar -> PR + fallback, Jordan -> monitor + alert, Rebecca -> schedule + doc, Kelly -> one-slide. I'll follow up tomorrow with a quick status update. :thumbsup:
